description: This file defines various functions and classes for creating and managing LSTM models and related neural network components, including different LSTM configurations, weight stacking, and model creation utilities, primarily for benchmarking purposes.

methods.name: flatten_list
methods.description: Flattens a list of lists into a single list.

methods.name: lstm_backward_setup
methods.description: Sets up backward pass for LSTM outputs, using simple_backward_setup.

methods.name: simple_backward_setup
methods.description: Prepares gradient output tensor for backward pass, optionally seeding the random generator.

methods.name: simple_backward
methods.description: Performs backpropagation given output and gradient output.

methods.name: pytorch_lstm_creator
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for a PyTorch LSTM model with given parameters.

methods.name: lstm_creator
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for an LSTM model, either scripted or not.

methods.name: lnlstm_creator
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for a LayerNorm LSTM, including mimicked layernorm computations.

methods.name: dropoutlstm_creator
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for an LSTM with dropout, using custom lstm module.

methods.name: lstm_premul_creator
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for an LSTM with premultiplied inputs and weights.

methods.name: lstm_premul_bias_creator
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for an LSTM with premultiplied inputs, weights, and bias.

methods.name: lstm_simple_creator
methods.description: Creates a simple flat-input ModelDef for benchmarking older JIT versions.

methods.name: lstm_multilayer_creator
methods.description: Creates a multilayer LSTM ModelDef.

methods.name: imagenet_cnn_creator
methods.description: Creates a CNN model for ImageNet architecture, optionally JIT traced.

methods.name: varlen_lstm_inputs
methods.description: Generates variable-length sequence inputs and initial hidden states for LSTM.

methods.name: varlen_lstm_backward_setup
methods.description: Sets up backward pass for variable-length sequence LSTM outputs.

methods.name: varlen_pytorch_lstm_creator
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for variable-length sequence LSTM with packing and padding.

methods.name: varlen_lstm_factory
methods.description: Creates a scripted dynamic RNN for variable-length sequences with custom cell.

methods.name: layernorm_pytorch_lstm_creator
methods.description: Creates a LayerNorm LSTM model, mimicking forward pass with layernorm.

methods.name: stack_weights
methods.description: Stacks a list of weight matrices into a packed tensor format for LSTM.

methods.name: lstm_inputs
methods.description: Generates initial inputs, hidden states, and weights for an LSTM model.

methods.name: lstm_factory
methods.description: Creates a scripted dynamic RNN for standard LSTM cell.

methods.name: lstm_factory_premul
methods.description: Creates a scripted dynamic RNN with premultiplied inputs and weights.

methods.name: lstm_factory_premul_bias
methods.description: Creates a scripted dynamic RNN with premultiplied inputs, weights, and bias.

methods.name: lstm_factory_simple
methods.description: Creates a simple scripted RNN for benchmarking older JIT versions.

methods.name: lstm_factory_multilayer
methods.description: Creates a scripted multilayer LSTM RNN.
